dialog.title: Settings
dialog.description: Manage importing, exporting, backing up and restoring your data, plus your master password and recovery key.

import.description: Import a file exported from another password manager.

export.description: Export the entries in the vault to a file.

emailBackup.description: Send all of your data to your own mailbox, or set up automatic backups.

restore.description: Choose a backup file, preview it and restore your data.

masterPassword.name: Master password
masterPassword.description: When on, the master password is required every time the app starts. When off, the app opens directly and your data files stay encrypted.

error.unexpected: The operation failed and your master password setting is unchanged. Please try again later.
error.unexpectedState: This operation is not allowed in the current state. Close this dialog, check the switch and try again.

enable.title: Turn on master password
enable.description: Once on, the master password is required to open your data the next time the app starts. You do not need to unlock again now.

disable.title: Turn off master password
disable.description: Once off, the app no longer asks for the master password when it starts.
disable.risk: Anyone who can sign in to this Windows account can open the app directly. Your data files stay encrypted, but if the system key stops working (after reinstalling Windows or resetting the Windows password), only the recovery key can get your data back, so make sure it is stored safely.
disable.acknowledgeLabel: I understand the protection after turning it off
disable.pendingNotice: Asking the system to protect the data key, which can take ten seconds or more.

error.wrongPassword: The master password is incorrect. Please try again.
error.notAcknowledged: Confirm that you understand the protection after turning it off.
error.systemUnavailable: The system cannot protect the data key right now and the master password stays on. Please try again later.

recoveryKey.name: Recovery key
recoveryKey.description: The recovery key is determined by your data key, so you can view it again at any time and it never changes.

verify.title: View recovery key
verify.description: After verification, the 24 recovery words are shown. They are the same as when first shown, and they cannot be replaced if leaked.
verify.acknowledgeLabel: I confirmed that no one else can see my screen
verify.unavailable: Cannot read the master password setting. Select Retry.
verify.autoHidden: For your safety, the recovery words were hidden automatically. Verify again to view them.

error.wrongPassword: The master password is incorrect. Please try again.
error.notAcknowledged: Confirm that no one else can see your screen.
error.unexpectedState: This operation is not allowed in the current state. Close this dialog, check the master password setting and try again.
error.unexpected: Reading failed and your vault is unchanged. Please try again later.

shown.title: Recovery key
shown.description: These 24 words are the same as when first shown, and they cannot be replaced if leaked. They are hidden automatically after {seconds} seconds, and closing this dialog clears them too.

error.tooShort: The master password needs at least {minLength} characters.
error.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.

onboarding.title: Set a master password
onboarding.description: The master password unlocks your data each time you open the app.
onboarding.forgetNotice: The master password is not stored. If you forget it, the 24 recovery words shown next are the only way to get your data back. Keep them safe.

error.notAcknowledged: Confirm that you understand that recovery needs the recovery words first.
error.systemUnavailable: The system cannot protect the data key, so you cannot skip. Set a master password.
error.unexpected: The operation failed. Close the app and try again.

skipConfirm.title: Skip the master password?
skipConfirm.description: Your data stays encrypted, but anyone who can sign in to this Windows account can open the app.

unlock.title: Unlock
unlock.description: Enter your master password to open your data.

error.wrongPassword: The master password is incorrect. Try again.
error.unexpected: Unlock failed. Close the app and try again.

failure.title: Unable to open your data
failure.description: A data file is missing or damaged, or the system cannot open the protected key. Close the app and try again. Do not delete the vault folder in the data directory. If you saved your recovery words, you can restore with them.

recovery.title: Recovery key
recovery.usage: If you forget the master password or the key file is lost, choose 'Forgot master password' or 'Restore with recovery words' on the unlock page and enter these 24 words in order.
recovery.warning: These 24 words work like a master key: anyone who has them can bypass the master password and open all of your data. Keep them offline. Do not store them in this vault, do not send them with an email backup, and do not photograph or upload them. If the words leak, they cannot be replaced in this version; if you lose the words and forget the master password, your data cannot be recovered.

file.dialogTitle: Save recovery words as a text file

show.title: Save your recovery words
show.description: If you forget the master password or the key file is lost, these 24 words are the only way to get your data back. Save them now. You will be asked to re-enter 3 of them next.
show.noCopy: Copying to the clipboard is not offered, so other programs cannot read the words.

save.textFileWarning: A text file is plain text. Sync tools, backups and cloud drives will carry it along, so save it somewhere that is not synced.
save.failed: Could not save the file. Try another location.

confirm.title: Confirm your recovery words
confirm.description: Enter words {positions} from your saved copy to confirm you saved them correctly.
confirm.wrongWord: Word {position} is not correct. Check it against your saved copy.

words.title: Restore with recovery words
words.description: Enter your 24 saved recovery words. Once they are verified you can set a new master password. Your existing data is not changed.
words.pasteHint: You can paste all 24 words into any box at once.

protection.title: Set new protection
protection.description: Your words are verified. Set a new master password for the vault, or continue without one.

error.unknownWord: Word {position} is not in the word list. Check the spelling.
error.checksum: A word is misspelled or out of order. Check each word.
error.keyRejected: These words do not match the current data. Make sure they belong to this vault.
error.systemUnavailable: The system cannot protect the data key. Set a master password.
error.unexpected: Recovery failed. Close the app and try again.
